commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Attach the Mockito agent explicitly instead of self-attaching

Java 21 warns that a library attaching an agent to its own JVM will stop working, so surefire now passes -javaagent with the mockito-core jar resolved by the dependency plugin, as Mockito's documentation recommends.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 4.1.1 on Java 21

Spring Integration 7.1 moved TcpInboundGateway from org.springframework.integration.ip.tcp to the ip.tcp.inbound subpackage; the import is the only source change. README now lists the jdk17 and jdk8 branches.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Add a TCP round-trip integration test

TcpServerIntegrationTests binds an OS-assigned port and asserts the replies over a plain socket, covering both a single request and consecutive requests on one connection. ApplicationTests now also uses port 0 so the suite does not clash with a locally running instance.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.5.16 on Java 17

No source changes were needed: the project uses no javax.* APIs, and the Spring Integration IP classes it relies on are unchanged in 6.5.x. README now points at the jdk8 branch for the Java 8 line.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Rewrite README with build, run, and protocol details

Document the CRLF framing required by the default ByteArrayCrLfSerializer, the tcp.server.port property, the message flow, and that the server is unauthenticated.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade Maven wrapper to 3.9.16

Regenerated with maven-wrapper-plugin 3.3.4 using the only-script distribution type, which drops the committed maven-wrapper.jar.

commits.author: zhwxp
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 2.7.18

2.7.18 is the last Spring Boot line supporting Java 8. Migrate ApplicationTests to JUnit 5, since spring-boot-starter-test no longer ships the JUnit 4 vintage engine.
